invariants: AUTHORSHIP != AUTHORIZATION != ORCHESTRATION != PROVIDER_EXECUTION != RUNTIME_EXECUTION != REVIEW
A stable locator is not a content digest
A commit or Drive revision is not by itself scientific or runtime proof
Cross-surface byte identity requires independently comparable content digests

surface_authority.github: Producer repository governs code, schemas, tests, CI definitions and implementation history.
surface_authority.drive: Google Drive governs documentary memory, CURRENT_STATE, indexes, receipts and documentary custody.
surface_authority.runtime: Termux, CI or another declared runtime governs only the execution observations it actually produced.
surface_authority.cross_surface: Federation binds identities and relations by pointers; it does not duplicate the underlying corpus.

actor_classes.role: Human principal who authorizes intent, scope or a promotion decision within provider policy.
Assistant that analyzes, routes and requests connector actions under the human-authorized scope.
Provider/API/service that applies an external mutation or read and returns the provider result.
Declared runtime that executes build, test, benchmark or validation commands.
Reviewer whose approval is distinct from authorship and execution when an independent review gate is required.
Explicit placeholder when the responsible actor or principal is not evidenced.

custody_profiles.purpose: Preserve exact implementation lineage for repository objects.
custody_profiles.evidence_rule: Readback must resolve the exact path at the recorded ref; content digest is required when byte identity matters.
custody_profiles.claim_boundary: Commit presence proves versioned history, not successful execution or correctness.

custody_profiles.purpose: Preserve PR, review, status-check, protection and merge promotion history.
custody_profiles.authority: GitHub provider state plus the declared human/provider approval policy.
custody_profiles.evidence_rule: Promotion is evidenced only against the exact reviewed head and provider-observed gate state.
custody_profiles.claim_boundary: Open PR or green partial CI does not equal authorized merge or canonical promotion.

custody_profiles.purpose: Bind GitHub Actions execution to the exact source revision.
custody_profiles.authority: GitHub Actions runtime for the observed run only.
custody_profiles.evidence_rule: PASS requires provider-observed successful run at the exact head and declared applicable checks.
custody_profiles.claim_boundary: Workflow definition is IMPLEMENTED_UNTESTED until an applicable run is observed.

custody_profiles.purpose: Track documentary identity and revision history without claiming byte immutability from fileId alone.
custody_profiles.evidence_rule: Readback must resolve the same fileId and observed revision/modified state.
custody_profiles.claim_boundary: Drive fileId is a stable locator, not a cryptographic content identity.

custody_profiles.purpose: Bind a Drive object or exported native document to exact materialized bytes.
custody_profiles.authority: Drive source plus the declared materialization process.
custody_profiles.evidence_rule: Digest must be computed over the exact materialized bytes; native document representation differences must be declared.
custody_profiles.claim_boundary: Native revision and exported bytes are related representations, not automatically byte-identical objects.

custody_profiles.purpose: Preserve traceability when names or parents change while identity may remain stable.
custody_profiles.authority: Google Drive metadata and append-only receipt.
custody_profiles.evidence_rule: Before and after metadata must be observed; unchanged fileId does not prove unchanged content.
custody_profiles.claim_boundary: Rename/move continuity is identity continuity only at the locator level unless content is independently hashed.

custody_profiles.purpose: Track derivation from inputs to outputs through a declared tool or command.
custody_profiles.authority: The runtime that executed the transformation.
custody_profiles.evidence_rule: Every derived output must point to evidenced inputs and an observed transformation event.
custody_profiles.claim_boundary: A documented transformation that was not executed remains IMPLEMENTED_UNTESTED.

custody_profiles.purpose: Preserve the identity and provenance of measurements, tests, checks, receipts and external anchors.
custody_profiles.authority: The producer of the evidence plus its exact source/runtime reference.
custody_profiles.evidence_rule: Evidence must be bound to the exact subject and scope it supports; promotion across scale requires an explicit bridge.
custody_profiles.claim_boundary: Evidence for one artifact, scale or run does not automatically support another.

custody_profiles.purpose: Separate human authorization, assistant orchestration, connector execution and provider result.
custody_profiles.evidence_rule: The assistant may route and request actions but cannot satisfy human authorization, independent review or self-promote a claim.
custody_profiles.claim_boundary: Assistant text is neither provider execution nor independent evidence unless linked to an observed tool/provider result.

custody_profiles.purpose: Bind non-secret credential and permission authority state without storing or exposing secret values.
custody_profiles.authority: Credential owner plus the provider permission system for the observed scope.
custody_profiles.evidence_rule: Record only non-secret metadata and provider-observed permission state. Secret values, tokens, passwords and private key material are never receipt content. Presence, validity, scope and successful use are distinct observations.
custody_profiles.claim_boundary: A configured secret name does not prove a secret value exists, is valid, has the declared scope, or was successfully used.

custody_profiles.purpose: Bind non-secret credential and permission authority state without storing or exposing secret values.
custody_profiles.authority: Credential owner plus the provider permission system for the observed scope.
custody_profiles.evidence_rule: Record only non-secret metadata and provider-observed permission state. Secret values, tokens, passwords and private key material are never receipt content. Presence, validity, scope and successful use are distinct observations.
custody_profiles.claim_boundary: A configured secret name does not prove a secret value exists, is valid, has the declared scope, or was successfully used.

custody_profiles.purpose: Bind one logical artifact across Drive and GitHub without duplicating corpus.
custody_profiles.authority: Federated relation record; implementation authority remains with the producer repo and documentary authority remains with Drive.
custody_profiles.evidence_rule: At least one stable identity anchor per participating surface is required; byte-equivalence claims additionally require comparable digests.
custody_profiles.claim_boundary: Pointer linkage proves relation, not byte identity, semantic identity or execution success.

custody_profiles.purpose: Preserve append-only state transitions and corrections.
custody_profiles.evidence_rule: Corrections append successor/supersedes records; historical records are not silently rewritten.
custody_profiles.claim_boundary: A receipt records an observed transition; it does not by itself promote the underlying claim.

cross_surface_binding.duplication_rule: Drive keeps map/index/receipts; GitHub keeps schemas/validators/tests/implementation. Cross-reference by ID/ref/hash instead of copying the corpus.
